$comment: Route prefixes that can show a price, a plan, or a purchase action. App Store Guideline 3.1.1 forbids all of them on iOS. This file is the SINGLE source of truth: src/lib/paymentRoutes.ts imports it for the runtime guards, and scripts/neutralize-ios-payment-routes.js requires it to decide which exported HTML to neutralize. Adding a payment surface means adding its prefix here and nowhere else.
